cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(bgfx_superbuild)

include(ExternalProject)

set(INSTALL_DIR ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/install)


# bgfx
ExternalProject_Add(bgfx_debug
	SOURCE_DIR ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/bgfx.cmake
	BINARY_DIR ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/build_debug/bgfx

	CMAKE_ARGS
		-DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug
		-DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=${INSTALL_DIR}/debug
		-DBGFX_DIR=${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/bgfx
		-DBX_DIR=${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/bx
		-DBIMG_DIR=${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/bimg

	USES_TERMINAL_BUILD TRUE
	INSTALL_COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} --install .
)

ExternalProject_Add(bgfx_release
	SOURCE_DIR ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/bgfx.cmake
	BINARY_DIR ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/build_release/bgfx

	CMAKE_ARGS
		-DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
		-DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=${INSTALL_DIR}/release
		-DBGFX_DIR=${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/bgfx
		-DBX_DIR=${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/bx
		-DBIMG_DIR=${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/bimg

	USES_TERMINAL_BUILD TRUE
	INSTALL_COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} --install .
)


# RmlUi
# RmlUi uses the system FreeType package for its default font engine.
# The installed package is consumed by the main Scalix build and dev tools.
foreach(CONFIGURATION IN ITEMS Debug Release)
	string(TOLOWER ${CONFIGURATION} CONFIGURATION_LOWER)
	ExternalProject_Add(RmlUi_${CONFIGURATION_LOWER}
		SOURCE_DIR ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/RmlUi
		BINARY_DIR ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/build_${CONFIGURATION_LOWER}/RmlUi

		CMAKE_ARGS
			-DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=${CONFIGURATION}
			-DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=${INSTALL_DIR}/${CONFIGURATION_LOWER}
			-DCMAKE_PREFIX_PATH=${INSTALL_DIR}/${CONFIGURATION_LOWER}
			-DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=OFF
			-DBUILD_TESTING=OFF
			-DRMLUI_SAMPLES=OFF
			-DRMLUI_FONT_ENGINE=freetype

		USES_TERMINAL_CONFIGURE TRUE
		USES_TERMINAL_BUILD TRUE
		INSTALL_COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} --install .
	)
endforeach()


# SDL
ExternalProject_Add(SDL_debug
	SOURCE_DIR ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/SDL
	BINARY_DIR ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/build_debug/SDL

	CMAKE_ARGS
		-DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug
		-DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=${INSTALL_DIR}/debug
		-DSDL_TESTS=OFF
		-DSDL_EXAMPLES=OFF

	USES_TERMINAL_BUILD TRUE
	INSTALL_COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} --install .
)

ExternalProject_Add(SDL_release
	SOURCE_DIR ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/SDL
	BINARY_DIR ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/build_release/SDL

	CMAKE_ARGS
		-DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
		-DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=${INSTALL_DIR}/release
		-DSDL_TESTS=OFF
		-DSDL_EXAMPLES=OFF

	USES_TERMINAL_BUILD TRUE
	INSTALL_COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} --install .
)


# SDL-image
ExternalProject_Add(SDL-image_debug
	SOURCE_DIR ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/SDL-image
	BINARY_DIR ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/build_debug/SDL-image

	DEPENDS SDL_debug

	CMAKE_ARGS
		-DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug
		-DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=${INSTALL_DIR}/debug
		-DCMAKE_PREFIX_PATH=${INSTALL_DIR}/debug
		-DSDLIMAGE_TESTS=OFF
		-DSDLIMAGE_SAMPLES=OFF

	USES_TERMINAL_BUILD TRUE
	INSTALL_COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} --install .
)

ExternalProject_Add(SDL-image_release
	SOURCE_DIR ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/SDL-image
	BINARY_DIR ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/build_release/SDL-image

	DEPENDS SDL_release

	CMAKE_ARGS
		-DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
		-DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=${INSTALL_DIR}/release
		-DCMAKE_PREFIX_PATH=${INSTALL_DIR}/release
		-DSDLIMAGE_TESTS=OFF
		-DSDLIMAGE_SAMPLES=OFF

	USES_TERMINAL_BUILD TRUE
	INSTALL_COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} --install .
)


# OpenCV
set(OPENCV_COMMON_ARGS
	-DBUILD_LIST=core,imgproc,imgcodecs,videoio,geometry,calib,stereo,ptcloud,features,photo,objdetect,video
	-DBUILD_opencv_dnn=OFF
	-DWITH_QT=OFF
	-DWITH_WIN32UI=OFF
	-DWITH_OPENGL=OFF
	-DWITH_DSHOW=ON
	-DWITH_MSMF=OFF
	-DWITH_OBSENSOR=OFF
	-DWITH_FFMPEG=OFF
	-DWITH_GSTREAMER=OFF
	-DVIDEOIO_ENABLE_PLUGINS=OFF
	-DBUILD_TESTS=OFF
	-DBUILD_PERF_TESTS=OFF
	-DBUILD_EXAMPLES=OFF
	-DBUILD_opencv_apps=OFF
	-DBUILD_opencv_python3=OFF
	-DBUILD_JAVA=OFF
)

ExternalProject_Add(opencv_debug
	SOURCE_DIR ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/opencv
	BINARY_DIR ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/build_debug/opencv

	CMAKE_ARGS
		-DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug
		-DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=${INSTALL_DIR}/debug
		${OPENCV_COMMON_ARGS}

	USES_TERMINAL_CONFIGURE TRUE
	USES_TERMINAL_BUILD TRUE
	INSTALL_COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} --install .
)

ExternalProject_Add(opencv_release
	SOURCE_DIR ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/opencv
	BINARY_DIR ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/build_release/opencv

	CMAKE_ARGS
		-DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
		-DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=${INSTALL_DIR}/release
		${OPENCV_COMMON_ARGS}

	USES_TERMINAL_CONFIGURE TRUE
	USES_TERMINAL_BUILD TRUE
	INSTALL_COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} --install .
)
